reason: Fast Landing root repair for the current Layered CI routing gap exposed by implementation PR #590. Repository design requires shared/release/** to escalate to at least L2 and layered-ci-fast.yml to provide PR/push risk classification, but the current pull_request paths omit shared/release/** and tests/wp0/**. As a result, governance evaluator changes can satisfy Stage/ACV2/Windows while failing to produce an automatic exact-head Layered PR run and must fall back to the long-lived governance/layered-ci-reviewed-candidate push ref, whose prior tip can be stale and therefore does not provide the normal PR base/head diff-range semantics. The cohesive root fix is to strengthen Layered PR routing by adding exactly shared/release/** and tests/wp0/** to the existing pull_request path filter, with a permanent workflow contract. No shared-ref rewrite, diff-range weakening, product/runtime/dependency change, or new workflow framework is authorized.

closureMatrix.rootCause: Layered PR routing omits governance evaluator and WP0 semantic test paths that repository design requires the Layered risk classifier to see.

boundaries.evidence: Current pull_request paths include governance/layered-ci/**, tools/layered-ci/**, tests/layered-ci/** and workflow/action paths but omit shared/release/** and tests/wp0/**.
Current workflow contract verifies jobs/risk selection but has no permanent assertion that shared/release/** and tests/wp0/** remain routed through Layered PR validation.
Once normal PR routing is restored, pull_request base/head SHA inputs already provide the correct exact range; no diff-range mutation is required.
Long-lived shared validation ref remains a push fallback and is not rewritten or made authoritative for PR range selection by this repair.

requiredSemantics: Layered CI Fast Feedback pull_request routing includes exact patterns shared/release/** and tests/wp0/** in addition to existing paths.
No existing Layered PR trigger path is removed or weakened.
A permanent layered workflow contract fails if either governance evaluator/WP0 pattern is removed.
Risk classification remains delegated to tools/layered-ci/select-ci-level.js and existing risk-policy.json; no L2 downgrade or promotion change is authorized.
Push fallback governance/layered-ci-reviewed-candidate remains available but is no longer required to obtain Layered runs for shared/release/** + tests/wp0/** PRs.
